items.title: S3 Multipart Upload Abort Rule
items.rationale: S3 lifecycle now aborts incomplete multipart uploads after 7 days.

items.title: Log Group Retention Period
items.rationale: Log group retention raised from 14 to 365 days.

items.title: CloudTrail KMS Encryption
items.rationale: Customer-managed KMS key planned for CloudTrail encryption.

items.title: CloudWatch Logs KMS Encryption
items.rationale: Customer-managed KMS key planned for log group encryption.

items.title: S3 Bucket KMS Encryption
items.rationale: Customer-managed KMS key planned for S3 bucket encryption.

items.title: Lambda VPC Association
items.rationale: Requires NAT Gateway / VPC endpoints; excluded for cost in baseline architecture.

items.title: X-Ray Active Tracing
items.rationale: Requires wildcard-resource write permission, conflicting with least privilege.

items.title: Lambda Reserved Concurrency
items.rationale: Can fail on new account quotas; concurrency throttled at account level.

items.title: Lambda Code Signing
items.rationale: Code signing configuration is out of scope for demo function.

items.title: Lambda Dead Letter Queue
items.rationale: DLQ applies to async invokes only; function is invoked directly.

items.title: Lambda Environment Encryption
items.rationale: Environment variable holds a parameter name, not a secret.

items.title: CloudTrail SNS Delivery
items.rationale: CloudTrail notification delivery via SNS has no notification requirement.

items.title: CloudTrail CloudWatch Integration
items.rationale: CloudTrail to CloudWatch Logs incurs extra cost; out of scope.

items.title: S3 Event Notifications
items.rationale: S3 event notifications not needed for a log bucket.

items.title: S3 Cross-Region Replication
items.rationale: Cross-region replication incurs extra cost; out of scope.

items.title: S3 Access Logging
items.rationale: Access logging on the log bucket creates a loop.
